Discover the situation

At the pharmacy or clinic

This week's theme is health and appointments. Today you will meet the English you need to describe a common symptom and ask for routine help at a pharmacy.

Discover the situation

Useful words for this situation.

Tap a card to see what each word means.

pharmacy

A shop that provides medicine.

medicine

Something you take when you are ill.

instructions

Information about how to use something.

pain

A hurting feeling in your body.

rest

Time to relax and recover.

water

A drink your body needs.

pharmacist

A person who gives medicine advice.
